info.title: EnergyGraph-AI Local Isolated Adapter Contract
info.description: Generated from the local Adapter application. This is not a formal Moodle or production API contract.

get.description: Expose a redacted operations view; never return credentials or raw URLs.
Expose a paginated, redacted audit stream to administrators only.
Expose a course-scoped pending discussion queue to administrators.

patch.description: Approve or reject one pending discussion item with an audit record.

get.description: Return the host-managed backup/recovery state without running shell commands.
Return a redacted, current-course user directory for administrators.
Return the configured-course directory with optional Moodle metadata.
Return resources attached to a graph node after session validation.
Show bounded golden-test evidence without exposing credentials or text logs.

post.description: Run one fixed question through the real configured Workflow before release.

put.description: Accept a raw PDF body and keep it outside the public web root.

post.description: Let an authenticated course member send visible content to moderation.

get.description: Expose only pseudonymous student metrics to authorized course staff.
Expose only course-scoped review data to teacher/admin sessions.

post.description: Ask the Workflow for a bounded draft score; teacher review remains required.
